quote: This paper proposes a novel pre-training method SIMLM for dense passage retrieval.
For evaluation metrics, we use MRR@10, Recall@50, and Recall@1k for MS-MARCO, nDCG@10 for TREC DL, and Recall@20, Recall@100 for the NQ dataset.
Results show substantial gains over other competitive methods using BM25 hard negatives only.
The TREC DL datasets have more fine-grained human annotations, but also much fewer queries.
